# Ebullientworks

The Ebullientworks theme styles Obsidian and Obsidian Publish in a dark and a light variant, applying responsive treatments to headers, modals, tables and panels. Colors, accents and fonts are configurable through built-in style settings, and the recorded description adds light styling for Admonitions and Calendar.

![Ebullientworks screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebullient/obsidian-theme-ebullientworks/HEAD/images/ebullientworks-theme.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ebullientworks"
    author: "ebullient"
    repo:   "ebullient/obsidian-theme-ebullientworks"
    slug:   "ebullientworks"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ebullientworks"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ebullient/obsidian-theme-ebullientworks"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebullient/obsidian-theme-ebullientworks/HEAD/images/ebullientworks-theme.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a clean dark and light theme with responsive, styled headers, modals, tables, and panels for Obsidian and Obsidian Publish. Customize colors, accents, and fonts, and use built-in style settings with light styling for Admonitions and Calendar."
}
```
